notes: The first image now uses a fixed Shopee PH main-image template system instead of random composition.
Five clean templates are supported: product top, title top, left product/right title, centered product with one-line title, and corner title.
The app recommends a template from the product category, and you can switch templates before or after generation.
Main images export at 800 x 800 as JPG quality 84 with safe margins, solid backgrounds, and editable product/title layers.
